chunks: Our Lord, indeed You cast into Hell whoever You will, and You have disgraced him; and for the sinners there are no helpers.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of those cast into Hellfire and their lack of helpers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to emphasize the ultimate humiliation of the unjust, reinforcing the concept that divine disgrace (khizy) is more severe than physical punishment. It highlights the isolation of the wrongdoers on the Day of Judgment, where no intercessor or ally can shield them from God's decree, a theme central to the narrative of the People of Imraan.
